Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier this week. Per our discussion I wanted to summarize the remaining deliverables we agreed to share with procurement so you can circulate them to your security and procurement teams: 

- SOC 2 Type II report (latest period) — full report for review (will be redacted for vendor distribution)
- Pen test summary document — high-level findings and remediation status
- ISO statements (scope and attestation summary)
- Condensed security overview deck for vendor review (one-pager + 6-slide summary)

I don’t want to flood your procurement inbox — we can deliver everything in a single secure package or provide per-item links depending on what your team prefers.

Next steps I propose:
1) I upload the four artifacts to a secured temporary link and send to procurement (3 business days)
2) Your procurement/security team confirms receipt and any additional checklist items (you asked about logging retention and encryption details)
3) We schedule a short technical walkthrough with Neha (our Security lead) if they want a live Q&A (15–30 min)

If that works, I’ll start the upload today and loop Neha to handle any content questions.

Best,

Jonas Weber

Jonas —

Thanks for the summary. Procurement would like the SOC 2 Type II (redacted is fine), a pen test executive summary that includes CVSS scores for any high/critical findings, and the ISO statement of applicability or attestation. The security deck is useful for the vendor packet.

A few clarifications from procurement/security:
- Can you confirm whether logs are retained for 90 days by default and how long KMS keys are rotated?
- Are the pen test remediation dates within the last 12 months?
- Will the SOC 2 include the auditor name and coverage dates?

Procurement prefers a single secured bundle link if possible. If you can provide the documents and include an audit contact for follow-up, that would speed sign-off.

Appreciate it — once we have materials I’ll route to legal for a quick review.

—Alyssa Chen
Director of Vendor Operations, Vellum Health

Alyssa —

Appreciate the checklist — we have everything ready. I uploaded a secured bundle to our temporary delivery area (link below) and included a Red Team / Pen Test executive summary with CVSS callouts, plus a redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF. The ISO statement and the condensed security deck are also in the bundle.

Deliverables (in bundle):
- Redwood_SOC2_Type2_2026.pdf (redacted)
- Redwood_PenTest_Summary_2026.pdf (exec summary, CVSS table)
- ISO27001_Statement_2026.pdf (scope & attestation summary)
- Security_Overview_Deck_Condensed.pptx (6 slides)

Quick answers to procurement questions:
- Log retention: default application logs are retained 90 days; system audit logs retained 365 days (configurable per plan).
- KMS rotation: keys are rotated as per customer-managed KMS policy; by default rotate every 12 months. We can provide KMS policy snippets if needed.
- Pen test timing: external pentest completed in 2026-08; remediation for high/critical findings completed by 2026-09-30.
- SOC 2: report includes auditor name (CedarAudit LLC) and coverage dates (2025-06-01 to 2026-05-31) in the redacted header.

Secure bundle link (expires in 14 days): https://s3.redwoodinference.com/sig-deliverables/VE-3217?token=eyJhb...
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ RW-VE-3217

If procurement wants verbatim logs or full SOC 2 unredacted, we require an NDA + controlled access; happy to work through that.

Would you like to schedule a 15–20 minute walkthrough with Neha sometime Wed/Thu this week? I’m CCing her to propose a few slots.

Thanks,

Hi Alyssa / procurement team —

I’m Neha (Head of Security at Redwood). Quick notes to help your review: 

- The pen test executive summary flags two historical medium findings that were mitigated via configuration changes; remediation evidence is available on request.
- For SOC 2 inquiries: the redacted report shows scope & controls tested; if you need the full report we require a data handling agreement + controlled access window.
- ISO statement included is the organization-level attestation; certificate copies are available under an NDA.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm whether the redacted artifacts satisfy procurement checklist (reply with any mandatory missing items)
2) If legal requests unredacted docs, please send the standard DPA/NDA and a request email to security-requests@redwoodinference.com
3) Book a 20-min Q&A with me if your technical reviewers would like to walk through the pen test CVSS table and mitigation timelines — available Wed 11/11 10:00–11:00 or Thu 11/12 14:00–15:00 PT.

Thanks — I’ll stand by to join the call and provide any additional artifacts.
